People Operations Generalist (HR)

Location: U.S. (Remote, but must be based in the United States)

 

ABOUT SPRUCE

Our mission is to let users control their data across the web. We are an engineering-forward organization that build privacy-preserving, standards-based digital identity and credentialing systems that help governments and institutions increase access to important services and benefits programs while reducing fraud.

 

THE ROLE

We're looking for a thoughtful, resourceful, and hands-on People Operations Generalist to join our team as our first dedicated People hire.

In this role, you'll take ownership of our day-to-day people operations while helping us build the processes, programs, and practices that support a growing, globally distributed team. You’ll work closely with the Head of Operations and company leadership to create a great employee experience, meet our compliance obligations, and maintain a healthy, high-performing culture.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a startup environment, and is excited to help shape the people function. When a new challenge arises, you ask questions, do the research, and bring in expert help when needed to find practical solutions. The ideal candidate will be approachable and build trust quickly, and is also organized, pragmatic, and comfortable navigating difficult conversations.

 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. People Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Own the employee lifecycle. Onboarding ensures each new hire is prepared and welcomed for a productive start. Offboarding creates a thoughtful and thorough transition that minimizes risk and treats departing employees with professionalism and care.

  • Serve as a trusted primary point of contact for employee questions related to policies, payroll, benefits, leave, and other people ops matters.

  • Maintain and improve HR processes, documentation, and internal resources, balancing consistency and compliance with the flexibility of a growing organization.

2. Compliance, Benefits & Global People Operations

  • Lead compliance across multiple U.S. states and international jurisdictions, working with external advisors and partners as needed.

  • Manage relationships with PEOs, benefits brokers, payroll providers, and other external HR partners, building effective collaboration, driving accountability on service quality, and surfacing recommendations when change is needed

  • Support leave administration, accommodations, and other employee matters with appropriate care, confidentiality, and attention to compliance.

3. Performance Management & Employee Relations

  • Help deliver consistent, well-organized performance review cycles that give employees useful feedback and managers a clear and efficient process.

  • Support managers in navigating performance conversations, employee relations matters, and other people-management challenges.

  • Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to improve manager effectiveness, communication, and employee engagement.

  • Handle sensitive employee matters with sound judgment, discretion, and empathy.

4. Recruiting & Hiring Support

  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to support an organized, efficient, and positive hiring process.

  • Facilitate offer preparation, pre-employment processes, and a smooth transition from candidate acceptance to employee onboarding.

  • Help ensure recruiting and hiring practices are consistent, equitable, and compliant across applicable jurisdictions.

5. Culture, Engagement & Team Events

  • Bring creative, practical ideas to add opportunities for our remote workforce to build relationships, feel connected, and engage with company culture.

  • Own employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, and internal communications.

  • Plan and coordinate company events and team gatherings, working with internal stakeholders and external vendors.

6. Building the People Ops Function

  • Evaluate existing people ops practices and identify opportunities to simplify, improve, or scale them.

  • Develop practical tools, processes, and resources that help employees and managers navigate people matters confidently and create actionable insights for leadership.

  • Collaborate with operations to establish priorities and build a people function that supports the company's long-term growth.

 

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 2–5 years of progressive experience in human resources, people operations, or a closely related function.

  • Experience working in a technology startup or similarly fast-moving environment and/or supporting a fully remote or highly distributed workforce.

  • Experience supporting employees across multiple U.S. states and international jurisdictions, with an understanding of the complexities of distributed employment.

  • Working knowledge of HR operations, employment compliance, benefits administration, and employee lifecycle management.

  • Experience working with PEOs, benefits providers, HRIS platforms, or other HR service partners.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust and work effectively with employees and managers at all levels.

  • Sound judgment, discretion, and a commitment to handling confidential and sensitive matters appropriately.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and comfort working independently in an environment where processes may still be evolving.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience supporting or administering performance management and employee development programs.

  • Experience with a heavily forward-deployed technical and product organization.

  • Experience planning company offsites, employee events, or engagement initiatives.

  • Experience developing culture and employee engagement programs for remote or distributed teams.

  • Experience in a technology company or other rapidly evolving business, particularly in scaling from 25-100 employees.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

Own growth-oriented product operations and strategy for the platform's core products, driving user trading through product mechanism optimization, content & community capabilities, segmentation, and personalized (1:1) product experiences and operating mechanisms — anchored on user lifecycle KPIs across signup, KYC, first deposit, first trade, active/repeat, dormancy, and winback.

Responsibilities

  1. Own Lifecycle OKRs: Deliver against eFTD/eFTT conversion, retention, resurrection rate, and user Net LTV. Set stage-specific operating strategies and growth cadences.
  2. Segmentation & Journey Design: Build a segmentation framework based on user attributes, behavior, and lifecycle stage (new / active / dormant / churned / high-value). Design and ship end-to-end User Journeys covering onboarding, first-deposit nudging, engagement, dormancy prevention, and winback.
  • Personalization at Scale (1:1): Build a granular segmentation and tagging system based on user attributes, behavior, lifecycle stage, and preference. Deliver personalized recommendations and differentiated strategies across product content, tasks, perks, incentives, and messaging so each user sees what's relevant to them.
  • Stage-Specific Interventions: Design and ship lifecycle programs for activation, engagement/habit-building, high-value cultivation, dormancy prevention, and winback — each solving the core problem of its stage.
  • Product Mechanism Ownership: Lead the design and iteration of trading-driving product mechanisms — task systems, tiering, perks/rewards, content and community (e.g., ByX).
  • Data & Experimentation: Track D1/D7/D30 retention, FTD conversion, repeat rate, and Net LTV; run independent analysis with AI; validate strategies and mechanisms through A/B testing.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Product, Data, Marketing, Algorithm, and regional teams to embed lifecycle and personalization strategies into product and operating plans.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in growth or product operations, with quantifiable growth results;
  • Deep understanding of the user lifecycle and growth funnel, with the ability to design scalable operating mechanisms;
  • Strong data-driven decision making, with a track record of shipping into production;
  • Fluent English; able to drive execution in a global team environment;
  • Hands-on data analysis and A/B testing experience; clear reasoning and strong execution;
  • Trading platform, financial, or FinTech product operations / growth background preferred;
  • Community operations experience at comparable competitor products preferred.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

  • Manage a high-volume portfolio of Start up/Growth clients, serving as a primary point of contact for day-to-day questions, requests, and follow-ups.

  • Build strong working relationships with clients while maintaining consistent communication and a positive client experience.
  • Help clients understand BitGo’s products, services, workflows, and available resources.

Client Support & Issue Resolution

  • Triage incoming client questions and issues, determine appropriate next steps, and coordinate resolution with internal teams.
  • Track open requests and follow through to ensure clients receive timely updates and clear outcomes.
  • Identify recurring client issues, service gaps, and opportunities to improve processes or client communications.
  • Escalate complex, sensitive, or business-critical matters to the appropriate Customer Success, Support, or Operations stakeholders.

  • Partner with Sales to support clients following onboarding and initial commercial engagement, ensuring a smooth transition into ongoing client management.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and other teams to help address client needs and remove friction.
  • Keep internal systems and client records up to date, documenting interactions, outstanding issues, and relevant account activity.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage a high volume of client requests while prioritizing effectively and maintaining a high standard of service.
  • Use established workflows, documentation, and internal resources to resolve common questions efficiently.
  • Monitor client engagement and recurring support needs to identify potential risks, opportunities, and accounts requiring additional attention.
  • Contribute to scalable processes that improve response times, consistency, and the overall client experience.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in Customer Success, client services, account coordination, customer support, sales support, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and professionally.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client requests and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • A client-first mindset with strong follow-through, sound judgment, and a bias toward resolving problems.
  • Comfort working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment where responsiveness and execution are essential.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms and client management tools; experience with Salesforce is a plus.

  • Client-focused: Takes ownership of client questions and works to deliver a reliable, positive experience.
  • Responsive and resourceful: Moves quickly, identifies solutions, and knows when to escalate.

  • Demonstrated interest in growing into a dedicated Customer Success Manager role.

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:

  • Competitive base salary, bonus and Equity
  • 100% company paid health insurance for employee, partner and dependents
  • Paid parental leave, paid vacation
  • Free custom lunches, dinners and snacks 
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and inspiring startup environment

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you’ll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

  • Account and trade lifecycle: account opening, settlement in Canada through CDS, failed trades, transfers, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits.
  • Platform gap analysis: comparing today's Alpaca platform with Canadian brokerage operations requirements to decide what we reuse, change, or build.
  • Launch scope: separating what must work on day one from what follows, including registered accounts (TFSA, RRSP, RESP), more products, and more partner services.

About Sentient

Sentient is building the future of open-source AI. Our mission is to ensure that the most powerful AI systems remain open, accessible, and beneficial to everyone.

Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera Capital, Sentient brings together world-class AI researchers, engineers, and builders to develop cutting-edge open-source AI technologies.

Our work spans AI agents, model verification, AI benchmarking, and self-improving AI systems. We're focused on turning frontier research into useful, widely adopted products that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source AI.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly technical, entrepreneurial Product Manager to help shape and build the next generation of AI products at Sentient.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and product development, identifying promising research breakthroughs and turning them into products that developers and businesses actually want to use.

This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to take ideas from early exploration through launch and adoption. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable exploring new technologies, prototyping solutions, engaging with users, and working alongside researchers and engineers.

You'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and leadership teams to determine what we should build, why it matters, and how to bring it to market. The role reports to the VP of Product and works alongside the team’s PM Lead, who will set overall product direction.

Location: Remote. The team is spread across Singapore, Hong Kong, and UAE, so you'll need regular overlap with Asia/Middle East working hours, with flexibility across timezones as we are a global team.

What You'll Do

  • Find product opportunities where our research, emerging technology, and market need meet, then set the vision, priorities, and roadmap.

  • Lead products from first concept through prototype, launch, and adoption, working with engineering, research, and go-to-market teams.

  • Work with AI researchers to spot promising breakthroughs and turn them into product requirements, user experiences, and technical specifications.

  • Evaluate technical approaches and make architectural trade-offs alongside engineering.

  • Build prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, using code, APIs, and current AI tooling: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, and developer infrastructure.

  • Design experiments and evaluations to test product hypotheses, and move quickly from idea to working demo to user feedback.

  • Talk directly with developers, design partners, and customers. Define and track adoption, engagement, performance, and retention, and feed what you learn back into product and research priorities.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • You have taken a technical product from concept to launch, and you can show us the product and its usage numbers.

  • You have worked as a software or ML engineer, or have equivalent hands-on technical depth.

  • You write Python well enough to build a working agent prototype against LLM APIs on your own.

  • You have designed and run evaluations for an LLM or agent system, and can explain why a given eval does or does not predict real-world performance.

  • You can point to a time you killed or reshaped a technically promising idea because users did not need it.

  • You have driven an initiative from start to finish without a defined brief or someone else setting the scope.

  • You can explain a research result to a customer and a customer problem to a researcher, clearly and in writing.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a founder, founding product manager, early-stage engineer, or technical product lead.

  • Experience building AI developer tools, AI agents, ML infrastructure, model evaluation systems, or open-source products.

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks and modern AI development workflows.

  • Experience collaborating with research scientists or bringing emerging AI technologies to market.

  • Contributions to open-source AI projects or active involvement in developer communities.

  • Experience working with design partners to validate and refine new products.

Why Join Sentient?

Why open source

At a closed lab, the product is access to a model. Here, the product is something developers can run, inspect, and build on themselves. That changes the job in three ways.

  • Your work is public. Most of what you ship lives in the open, where anyone can read it, fork it, and challenge it. Your track record is visible to the whole field, not locked inside one company.

  • Your users are your collaborators. Developers file issues, send pull requests, and tell you what is broken within days. You learn faster than any private beta allows.

  • You build for adoption, not lock-in. A product wins here because developers choose it, not because they have no alternative. That is a harder bar and a more honest one.

What else you get

  • Work at the frontier of AI: Collaborate with leading researchers and engineers on technologies shaping the future of artificial intelligence.

  • Meaningful ownership: Have a direct impact on product strategy, technical direction, and execution.

  • Research meets real-world impact: Translate innovative AI research into practical products used by developers and organizations.

  • Builder-driven culture: Work with an ambitious team that values experimentation, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results.

If you're passionate about AI, enjoy building products from the ground up, and want to shape the future of open-source AI, we'd love to hear from you.
